gen-audiowide-gf-anuphan: Anuphan reads friendly and round, its big lowercase bowls leaving clear gaps in every curve of a plain sans. Audiowide makes it the sharper of the two.
gen-audiowide-gf-arimo: Arimo reads like a plain sans with a tall mean line and terminals that stay wide open in the rounds. Audiowide earns its place big and brief.
gen-audiowide-gf-armata: Armata gives a sans text with generous gaps between characters and lowercase that fills most of the letter height. Make it larger and Audiowide's tiles still stand apart.
gen-audiowide-gf-athiti: Athiti reads approachable, with a high mean line and an s you can see straight through, like a plain sans cut from vinyl. And Audiowide's tiled letters keep a long page feeling light and unhurried.
gen-audiowide-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible has wide-set terminals on its s and capitals that feel a touch clipped beside the lowercase. Audiowide's gentle, constant line gives a longer passage a steady, friendly pace.
gen-audiowide-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-n: Approachable lowercase eyes as big as washers, with rounds left unlatched like a hook, give Atkinson Hyperlegible Next its open face. Audiowide's constant ribbon of line leaves a longer passage easy going.
gen-audiowide-gf-biryani: Biryani reads friendly, with a large clear eye on every e. Audiowide's futuristic tiles sit above a sans with no thick-and-thin modulation, so a longer stretch of it stays unclogged and easy on the eye.
gen-audiowide-gf-blinker: Blinker reads clean and approachable, its lines holding their thickness while open apertures fill most of the height. Blinker is the sans-serif that lets Audiowide's tech edge be the only loud thing.
gen-audiowide-gf-carrois-gothic: Audiowide's wide-spaced, tile-like glyphs carry a futuristic charge, all drawn with one steady outline. But the sans-serif Carrois Gothic needs no help, and Audiowide earns its keep big and short.
gen-audiowide-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC keeps clear openings at the end of every curve, with capitals and lowercase nearly the same height. But shrink Audiowide and its technical-pen steadiness gets lost beside it.
